comparison_limitations.detail: Entity unchanged compares only declared graph semantic fields (identity/status/ROS name/executable/interface kind/message type/version/vehicles). It does not prove unchanged implementation or configuration source; V1 has no per-file manifest and its hashes are graph-page provenance.
V1 relations use codex-v1-export-1 while V2 uses codex-v2-staging-1; relation deltas can reflect extractor coverage/schema drift as well as architecture changes.

comparison_scope.relation_delta_meaning: semantic graph delta mixed with extractor coverage/schema drift; needs review
comparison_scope.relation_removal_policy: V1-only relations are extraction_limited and are not definitive breaking removals.
